$comment: Response headers every Tutors app must send on every response (runway tier M). Checked against the built image by scripts/checks/container-smoke.ts --app <name>. Known gaps live in known-response-gaps.txt, which may only shrink.

X-Frame-Options.reason: Stops other sites framing the reader (clickjacking); CSP frame-ancestors is the modern equivalent.

X-Content-Type-Options.reason: Stops browsers treating uploaded or course content as a different type.

Referrer-Policy.reason: Course and student routes must not leak in full to third-party embeds.

Permissions-Policy.reason: No Tutors page needs camera or microphone; embedded content must not ask.

Strict-Transport-Security.reason: Pins HTTPS for at least ~115 days. Browsers ignore it over plain HTTP, so sending it locally is harmless.

Content-Security-Policy.reason: Limits where scripts, frames and styles may load from; the main defence if course markdown ever renders unsafe HTML.
